entities.summary: Hagsätra is a district (stadsdel) in Söderort, the southern part of Stockholm Municipality, Sweden. It is part of the Enskede-Årsta-Vantör borough (stadsdelsområde). It borders with the districts of Älvsjö, Örby and Rågsved in Stockholm, as well as Stuvsta in neighboring Huddinge Municipality. Hagsätra covers an area of 420 acres (170 ha) and, as of December 2023, has a population of 9934.
